verdict.rationale: Cekura documents a first-party GitHub Actions CI/CD guide for automatically testing agents on every code change or pull request, so the CI half of the story is directly covered. The evidence never shows that a failing eval run fails the job or blocks a deployment; rubric thresholds exist but are not tied to CI pass/fail. missing for 10: documented pass/fail exit codes or threshold-based deployment gating in CI, hands-on or independent corroboration of the CI workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run evals in CI and gate deployments on their results
